summary: Build practical pension investment policies, ALM analysis, and risk guidelines in five days. Develop usable governance tools and enrol today.
lede: Pension investment policy training helps trustees, investment managers, and risk specialists connect plan obligations with portfolio rules and governance decisions. Participants practise drafting an Investment Policy Statement, profiling liabilities, setting asset allocation and risk limits, testing liquidity scenarios, and reviewing manager performance to support consistent monitoring and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who influence pension investment policy, portfolio construction, oversight, or governance. It suits intermediate learners who already work with investment concepts and need a more disciplined policy and guideline process.
modules: Strategic Asset Allocation and Risk Budgets
Liquidity, Stress Testing, and Scenario Analysis
Policy Integration and Investment Committee Reporting
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of investment markets, portfolio concepts, and pension fund governance. Prior experience reviewing an Investment Policy Statement, manager report, or asset allocation paper is useful. No programming is required. Advanced analytics, Monte Carlo analysis, and AI-assisted monitoring are taught at operational application level, using supplied spreadsheets and templates rather than technical model development.
